Implementation of the paper "Beyond Action Residuals: Real-World Robot Policy Steering via Bottleneck Latent Reinforcement Learning" (https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19919).

# Beyond Action Residuals: Steering Robot Manipulation Policies with Bottleneck Latent Reinforcement Learning (ZPRL) [Dongjie Yu](https://manutdmoon.github.io/) *,1,2 , [Kun Lei](https://lei-kun.github.io/) *,2,3 , [Zhennan Jiang](https://jzndd.github.io/) 4 , [Jia Pan](https://www.ai.hku.hk/people/academic-staff/jpan) #,1 , [Huazhe Xu](http://hxu.rocks/) #,2,5 * Equal contribution # Corresponding authors 1 School of Computing and Data Science, HKU; 2 Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute; 3 Shanghai Jiao Tong University; 4 Institute of Automation, CAS; 5 IIIS, THU **TL;DR**: ZPRL is an RL finetuning framework that perturbs bottleneck latents to steer robot manipulation policies, achieving efficient steering and smooth robot actions. ## Installation 1. Clone the repository. 2. Create a virtual environment and install the required dependencies. We used [mamba](https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge) for fast env management, but you can also use conda. Then add `export MUJOCO_GL=egl` to your `~/.bashrc`. If osmesa/glfw/glew issues still exist during training, check this [page](https://docs.pytorch.org/rl/0.6/reference/generated/knowledge_base/MUJOCO_INSTALLATION.html) for possible solutions. 3. Check your `~/.bashrc` and locate `MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX` or `CONDA_PREFIX`. Then add either or correspondingly to your `~/.bashrc` if there is no such command. 4. Install `robosuite` and `robomimic`. We use specific versions for both to leverage Python bindings of `mujoco` so we do not have to install `mujoco-py` and download more files. 5. We made a small patch to `robosuite` to correct its GPU rendering on the specified device and enable faster parallel simulation. Replace `/your/path/to/dependencies/robosuite/robosuite/renderers/context/egl_context.py` with [this](patches/egl_context.py) and replace `/your/path/to/dependencies/robosuite/robosuite/utils/binding_utils.py` with [this](patches/binding_utils.py). >[!abstract] 一句话总结：ZPRL 提出一种瓶颈潜在强化学习框架，通过在策略瓶颈层（bottleneck latent）上施加强化学习扰动来引导机器人操作策略，而非在动作空间直接做残差修正，从而在低维潜在空间中实现高效策略转向并保持动作顺畅。


# 一、动机

> 现有动作残差类方法在真实世界机器人策略引导中通常面临采样效率低、动作不平滑且难以部署的问题，亟需一种既能高效引导预训练策略又能保持动作质量的微调范式。


# 二、方法

> ZPRL 提出一种瓶颈潜在强化学习框架，通过在策略瓶颈层（bottleneck latent）上施加强化学习扰动来引导机器人操作策略，而非在动作空间直接做残差修正，从而在低维潜在空间中实现高效策略转向并保持动作顺畅。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文报告 ZPRL 在真实机器人操作任务上实现了高效策略引导与平滑动作控制，相对动作残差基线具有更好的实际部署表现（具体数字如任务成功率、动作平滑性指标需查阅论文原文，本仓库未列出）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该代码库提供了基于 robosuite/robomimic 的完整实现和并行渲染补丁，便于复现。启发是：在瓶颈潜在空间而非动作空间进行强化学习扰动，可能成为面向真实机器人策略安全微调的新方向，对预训练操作策略的高效适配具有参考价值。与课题直接相关，值得精读。与课题直接相关，值得精读。
